in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Sascha' is derived from the Hebrew word 'שָׁשַּח' (shasha), which means 'god is gracious'. This name is not found in the Bible, but it is a beautiful and meaningful name with biblical roots.

in_greek.name: Σασχά
in_greek.long_meaning: The name 'Sascha' in Greek is 'Σασχά' (Sascha), which means 'savior'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it is a derivative of the Greek word 'σόζω' (sōzō), which means 'to save'.

in_latin.name: Sascha
in_latin.long_meaning: The name 'Sascha' in Latin is the same as in English. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'שָׁשַּח' (shasha), which means 'god is gracious'. In Latin, the name is often used as a variation of the name 'Sascha' or as a nickname for names like 'Sacharissa' or 'Sacharie'.
